_note: MCP server template. Copy to data/mcp_servers.json (the app reads that path on startup); data/ is gitignored, so your keys stay local. Each entry is its own subprocess, and `command` is resolved against the app's PATH — a bare "python" means THE APP'S interpreter.
_note_venv: A server that needs a different mcp SDK version runs in its own venv and points `command` at that venv's python.exe by absolute path. Do not upgrade the app's mcp instead: amap-mcp-server pins mcp==1.8.1, and mcp>=1.30 on Python 3.14 needs starlette>=0.48 while fastapi needs <0.47 — the conflict is structural (ADR-0010).
_note_tools: Tools from these servers are registered as mcp__<server>__<tool> and always require approval. The app writes no adaptation for any single server: no tool name, argument name or env var is hardcoded for a specific one (ADR-0010). Screen reading is not an MCP concern any more — see_screen uses the main model, falling back to the vision specialist (VISION_* in .env).
